name: @recordist/gateway

tools.name: list_meetings
tools.description: List recent meetings captured by Recordist, newest first. Optional full-text filter `q`, a date range (`from`/`to`) and paging (`limit`/`offset`). Returns id, title, start time, duration, source app, status, attendees and tags.

q.description: Full-text filter across titles, transcripts and notes

tools.name: get_meeting
tools.description: Fetch one meeting by id including its AI notes (summary, decisions, …), action items and markers. Use `get_transcript` for the full transcript.

tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Return a meeting's transcript. `format` is one of json (segments with ms timestamps), md, srt, vtt or txt (default md). Speaker labels and timestamps are included.

format.description: json | md | srt | vtt | txt (default md)

tools.name: search_meetings
tools.description: Full-text search across all transcripts and notes. Returns matching snippets with the meeting id, title, time offset and speaker so you can jump to the moment.

query.description: Search terms (FTS5 syntax supported; plain words are ANDed)

tools.name: get_action_items
tools.description: List action items extracted from meetings. Filter by `meeting_id` and/or `open_only` (exclude completed items).

open_only.description: Only items not marked done (default false)

tools.name: regenerate_notes
tools.description: Ask the Recordist app to write a meeting's AI notes again. They replace the current notes and open action items (Recordist keeps the earlier ones under Earlier notes; the person's own notes stay). `kind` is summary, action_items, decisions, questions, followup_email or custom; `template_id` selects a template. Requires the app to be running.

tools.name: start_recording
tools.description: Record a meeting via the Recordist app. If the person turned on 'Allow agents to start recordings' in Recordist (Settings, Integrations), the recording starts at once. Otherwise, the safe default, Recordist shows its own record card on the person's laptop and nothing records until they answer it; the result says which happened. Requires the app to be running.

source_app.description: zoom | teams | meet | slack | webex | facetime | manual (default manual)

tools.name: stop_recording
tools.description: Stop the recording under way. This ends the person's recording of their call, so only stop it when they ask you to. Transcription and notes continue in the background. Requires the app to be running.

tools.name: add_marker
tools.description: Bookmark the current moment in the active recording with an optional label. Requires the app to be running.

tools.name: propose_action
tools.description: Suggest an action on the person's record for them to approve in the Recordist app: draft the follow-up (kind draft_followup: meeting_id, optional template_id), mark a promise done (kind mark_promise_done: action_item_id), or export a meeting (kind export_meeting: meeting_id, optional format md|txt|srt|vtt|json). Nothing runs on this call. Recordist shows a card that says exactly what will happen and waits for the person to press Approve or Not now; a suggestion nobody answers runs out. Use `reason` to say why, in one sentence; it is shown on the card in your words. Poll `action_status` for the answer. Requires the app to be running and 'Let connected assistants suggest actions' turned on in Settings → Integrations → Recordist Agent.

action_item_id.description: mark_promise_done: the promise's id from get_action_items

template_id.description: draft_followup: the template; default the meeting's own

reason.description: Why you suggest it, in one sentence, shown to the person

via.description: The assistant's name, shown on the card (for example 'Claude Desktop')

tools.name: action_status
tools.description: The status of an action you suggested with propose_action: proposed (waiting), done, failed, declined (the person said Not now) or expired (nobody answered in time). Only the status and the time of the answer come back; the card's words and any result stay in the app. Requires the app to be running.

instructions: Recordist is a local-first meeting recorder. Use list_meetings / search_meetings to find meetings, get_meeting for notes and action items, get_transcript for the full text. Recording controls (start_recording, stop_recording, add_marker) and regenerate_notes need the Recordist desktop app to be running; reads also work offline from the local database. start_recording starts at once only when the person allowed agents to; otherwise Recordist asks them on its own card. Stop a recording only when the person asks. Meetings are also exposed as resources: recordist://meeting/{id} and recordist://meeting/{id}/transcript.
